$comment: The tests of every row of the error model (public-api: One error model for Tiehall's own refusals), by the row's problem type as packages/core/src/error-model.ts names it. Each row names its test on REST, as a test file of the repository and the exact title of a test in it, or says why no operation of /api/v1 reaches the row and names the test of the HTTP endpoint that does. Each row names its test on MCP, a test that shows the refusal as a tool error, or says why tool errors do not apply to it, with the test of /mcp's HTTP status where /mcp gives one. A file shows its row by naming its problem type, or the text `names` gives. pnpm check:error-model checks this file.

rest.case: answers a path that serves no operation with 404 route-not-found

mcp.case: answers a tool it does not offer with a tool error for a route that is not there

rest.case: answers a record that does not exist with 404 record-not-found

mcp.case: answers a refusal as a tool result with isError, whose content is the problem and names its type, inside an HTTP 200

rest.case: answers an operation with 503 and the problem type setup-required

mcp.not: Before setup completes, the setup gate answers every call to /mcp, as to /api/v1, before any tool runs, with the HTTP status 503 and the problem.

test.case: keep the setup gate's answers before setup completes: the problem for /api/v1 and /mcp whatever they accept, and pages sent on to /setup

rest.case: answers a call during shutdown with 503, Retry-After: 0 and a problem, lets the call in flight finish, and exits 0

mcp.not: While the app shuts down, the web role answers every new call before any route, /mcp's included, with the HTTP status 503 and Retry-After: 0.

test.case: answers a call during shutdown with 503, Retry-After: 0 and a problem, lets the call in flight finish, and exits 0

rest.case: answers input that fails the schema with 400 invalid-input

mcp.case: refuses what is neither a key nor a URL as input that fails the schema

rest.not: The one refusal of this row, a personal access token's lifetime above the admin's maximum, comes from creating a token, which runs only in the web UI with the confirmation step, so no operation of /api/v1 reaches it.

test.case: above the admin's shorter maximum is refused with 400, even when the review page was opened before the admin shortened it

mcp.not: Creating a personal access token is offered on no agent surface, so no tool reaches this row.

rest.case: gets 400 upgrade-required with directions to upgrade, and the operation does not run

mcp.not: Only the CLI names its version, on its calls to /api/v1; an MCP client names none, so no tool call is refused for one.

rest.case: gets 403 for a user in no team, and creates nothing

mcp.case: refuses a member of no team with 403, and opens nothing

rest.not: A sign-in is refused on GitHub's return to the sign-in callback, a route of the sign-in service, which no operation of /api/v1 is.

test.case: is refused with 403 and the text that says to ask an admin for an invite, and gets no session and no user

mcp.not: Signing in happens in a browser, through the sign-in service; no tool signs anyone in.

rest.case: applies to the next call: once it is off, the script's next call with the same token gets 403 and no data

mcp.case: answer a personal access token's call with a tool error naming personal-access-tokens-off once an admin has switched them off

rest.not: The actions that need the confirmation step run only from the web UI, and no operation of /api/v1 offers one.

test.case: without a valid confirmation gets 403, and creates nothing

mcp.not: The actions that need the confirmation step are offered on no agent surface, so no tool reaches this row.

rest.case: answers a caller who has been removed from the install with 403 removed-member

mcp.case: gets a tool error that names the removed member's problem, and no data of the install

rest.not: A request state is what a retry carries on /mcp after a URL-mode elicitation; /api/v1 takes none.

test.case: refuses with HTTP 403 a state bound to another user, or to another client of the same user

mcp.not: A refused request state is an HTTP status on /mcp, 403, not a tool error, as the error model says.

test.case: refuses with HTTP 403, not as an error inside a 200, a state that was changed, and nothing changes on the proposal

rest.case: is refused with 401 invalid_token when it was seen before: a replayed token takes no report

mcp.not: An invalid bearer token on /mcp gets the OAuth refusal, HTTP 401 with invalid_token, not a tool error.

test.case: holding an access token issued before they rejoined gets HTTP 401 invalid_token, the OAuth refusal of a revoked token

rest.case: is refused with 403 on any other operation, and with 404 on a path that serves none

mcp.not: A CI caller calls only contract.report, on /api/v1; on /mcp its token is no access token, and gets the OAuth refusal.

rest.case: accepts the seventh write within 10 minutes and flags the request with it; the next agent write gets 409 needs-human

mcp.case: answer an agent's write to a request flagged needs_human with a tool error naming needs-human, and post nothing

rest.case: answers a state conflict with 409 conflict

mcp.case: answers a refusal as a tool result with isError, whose content is the problem and names its type

rest.case: answers a 3 MiB requests.create body with 413 payload-too-large, and creates nothing

mcp.not: A body over the size limit is refused before any route, /mcp's included, with the HTTP status 413, not a tool error, as the error model says.

test.case: answers a body over 2 MiB to /mcp with the HTTP status 413, not with a tool result in a 200

rest.case: gets 428 without If-Match, even when the body names a revision, and adds nothing

mcp.case: refuses a packet change that names a stale expected revision, or none, as REST refuses a mismatched or missing If-Match, and creates no proposal

rest.case: accepts the 60th write in 60 seconds from one token and refuses the 61st with 429 and Retry-After

mcp.case: answer an agent's write past the install's daily budget with a tool error naming rate-limited, which says when to retry, and post nothing

rest.case: is refused with 502 and links nothing when GitHub fails the read

mcp.case: answer link_pr with a tool error naming integration-unavailable when GitHub fails the read of the pull request, and link nothing

rest.case: answers a call without credentials with 401 as a problem, once the path serves an operation

mcp.not: A call to /mcp without a token gets the OAuth refusal, HTTP 401 with a challenge, not a tool error.

test.case: answers a call without a token with 401 and a challenge that points to the protected resource metadata and carries a scope hint

rest.case: refuses a message from a token with only requests:read with 403 insufficient_scope naming requests:write, and posts nothing

mcp.not: A token without a scope a tool needs gets the OAuth refusal on /mcp, HTTP 403 with insufficient_scope, before the tool runs.

test.case: answers a token without the scope a tool needs with HTTP 403 insufficient_scope, before anything runs

rest.case: gets 428 for a packet change without If-Match, even when the body names the revision, and 412 for a stale one, and proposes nothing

mcp.case: refuses a packet change that names a stale expected revision, or none, as REST refuses a mismatched or missing If-Match, and creates no proposal

rest.case: refuses a reused key with a different body with 422, and does not run

mcp.not: Idempotency-Key is a header of /api/v1's POST operations; MCP has no such header.
